title: Pipewright UseCase (ML persona). Validated after include files and environment files are merged.

run_in.description: The environments this use case runs in (Pipewright 1.1). Left out: every environment

include.description: Glob patterns (relative to the use case folder) of files holding spec sections

monitoring.description: 1.4.3 (FR-98): your monitor steps on the live window capture recorded (monitoring.online); released with the use case, run on monitoring.online.schedule

base_image.description: the component image's base instead of the environment's (e.g. a CUDA image for GPU training), within its approved base images (Pipewright 1.2.0)

feature_contract.description: Pipewright 1.4.1 (FR-103): the approved definitions of the feature sources this use case reads (data.features_from), written by `pipewright features contract`.

name.description: the feature group, or the table's ID

sql_file.description: a table built by a query: the SQL that builds it, relative to the use case folder

sql_files.description: a table written by several jobs (for example a backfill and a monthly append): each job's SQL; the first is recorded as sql_sha256, the others as also_sql_sha256 (1.4.2)

scheduled_query.description: a table built by a scheduled query: its transfer config name

on_release.description: pipewright release runs tests.command first and stops on a non-zero exit (default false)

environment.description: where tests.command runs: Pipewright's own interpreter (the default) or a cached virtual environment with the components' requirements

external_tables.description: BigQuery external tables over the files (store gcs)

pipeline_name.description: synthetic: the pipeline Pipewright provides when synthetic.enabled

schedule_pipeline_name.description: synthetic: the pipeline Pipewright provides when synthetic.enabled; online_sync (FR-104): the launcher runs the tenant's sync job, which refreshes the use case's online store (model.serving.online_store bigquery or cloudsql)

landing.description: null turns file landing off (e.g. in one environment)

online_view.description: the feature view online serving reads this source from (default: the feature group's name)

per_series.description: forecasts: every series (bqml.forecast.id_columns) must pass, not only the overall value (Pipewright 1.2.0)

fairness.description: bias measures per attribute on the test set, gated like other metrics (Pipewright 1.1)

type.description: mostlyai: MOSTLY AI SDK in local mode (default); sdv: only if your team installs SDV (synthetic.requirements) under its own licence

model.description: mostlyai: MOSTLY_AI/Small, Medium or Large; sdv: gaussian_copula, ctgan, tvae or copulagan

differential_privacy.description: train with a differential privacy budget (mostlyai)

max_epochs.description: mostlyai (1.4.3): train for this many epochs; max_training_minutes stays the ceiling. With seed, the run repeats anywhere

seed.description: 1.4.3: one seed for training and generation; null = a different random state each run

bqml.description: BigQuery ML as the training engine: Pipewright provides the training and scoring pipelines (model_type, or import)

forecast.description: a forecast (data.label.task forecast, Pipewright 1.1): the series is data.label.column over data.split.time_column, one series per id_columns value

engine.description: arima_plus (CREATE MODEL), or ai_forecast (AI.FORECAST, where policies.bqml.ai_forecast allows it)

context_window.description: ai_forecast only: the latest points the model reads

import.description: a model trained elsewhere, imported into BigQuery ML instead of trained there (Pipewright 1.1)

metrics_table.description: a table in outputs.bigquery.tables that gets one row per training run, approved or refused, as the container examples' metrics table does

contract_on.description: the rows the data contract checks: prepared (the default, as in 1.x) or source (as read, before bqml.prepare, as the container path checks them)

ab_test.description: A/B testing of models (Pipewright FR-57; off unless enabled): the champion against a candidate, units assigned stickily by a hash of the test name and the unit key, a business metric and guardrails fixed in advance, a person decides

layer.description: FR-123 (off unless set): tests of any use case in this environment that name the same layer never share a unit; this test takes share_bp of the layer's units, the rest are not in it

name.description: what the metric is called in the results, such as renewed_90d

source.description: a bq:// table of outcome events: one row per event, with the unit key and a time

key.description: the unit key's column in the source (default: ab_test.unit)

time_column.description: when each event happened; events count within window_days after a unit's first exposure

value_column.description: mean and ratio: the value summed per unit (revenue, orders)

denominator_column.description: ratio: the denominator summed per unit (sessions, visits)

where.description: a SQL condition on the source's rows, such as event_type = 'renewal'

name.description: what the metric is called in the results, such as renewed_90d

source.description: a bq:// table of outcome events: one row per event, with the unit key and a time

key.description: the unit key's column in the source (default: ab_test.unit)

time_column.description: when each event happened; events count within window_days after a unit's first exposure

value_column.description: mean and ratio: the value summed per unit (revenue, orders)

denominator_column.description: ratio: the denominator summed per unit (sessions, visits)

where.description: a SQL condition on the source's rows, such as event_type = 'renewal'

include_by.description: FR-122: the feed's copy of an event keeps who acted (by); off by default

synthetic.description: synthetic data generation (off unless enabled): an engine learns from real data inside the environment, or rules generate rows from the data contract alone

purpose.description: sets the default gates: test-data stays in the organisation, sharing leaves it

source_uri.description: learned: the data the engine learns from, read point in time like training

candidates.description: engine variants tried side by side; the best one passing every gate is kept

columns.description: columns decided by rules, not learned (keys, personal data, time grids)

gates.description: overrides of the purpose's gates; privacy gates may only be made stricter

requirements.description: extra packages for the synthetic image (e.g. SDV, which your team installs)

mode.description: relational: the entity table and its child tables (feature tables, sequences) learned together

output_tables.description: relational: each child table's output table (in outputs.bigquery.tables), by child name

sequences.description: relational: event tables per entity (transactions, sessions), generated in order with the entity table

retraining.description: what drift or a performance drop does: off (alerts only), propose (a person decides), candidate (trains a candidate, never promotes)

mode.description: YAML reads an unquoted off as false: both mean off

enabled.description: older switch: true means mode propose, false means off

when.description: not `on`: YAML reads on as true

cooldown_days.description: after an approved retrain, new alerts are recorded but open no case

source_uri.description: default training data for an approved retrain (an approver may choose another)

loop.description: the closed retrain loop (FR-48): an approved case here trains in the environment releases come from (promotion.from), not here

safeguards.description: limits on loops started without a person (retraining.mode candidate); {} for the defaults (1 loop per 7 days, pause after 2 failures in a row, drift on 2 runs in a row)

pause_after_failures.description: automatic loops in a row that end rejected, failed or rolled back before automatic retraining pauses (default 2)

drift_runs.description: a drift trigger counts only when this many scoring runs in a row alerted (default 2)

canary.description: the online canary with automatic rollback (Agent Platform endpoints): the loop deploys the candidate as a canary, checks it after a soak window, then promotes it or rolls it back

max_error_rate_increase.description: error rate above the current version's, as a fraction of requests (default 0.01)

max_latency_increase.description: median latency above the current version's, as a ratio (default 0.2: 20% slower at most)

min_requests.description: canary requests in the soak window before latency is compared (default 50)

probe.description: send the validation rows to the canary; their scores must match test's (default true)

data.description: whose data configuration (feature tables, label window) the loop's training run in test reads: test's (default) or production's, through its read-only loop_readers grant

notify.description: emailed the case summary and ID; email never approves

publish.description: also deliver decision events to the tenant's decision feed (a platform-provisioned subscription)

digest.description: weekly summary of open cases and decisions

required.description: approver groups registered by the platform (manifest approver_groups); one approval from each

reopen_when_worse_by.description: re-open a snoozed or declined case at once when the worst PSI rises by this much

online.description: 1.4.3 (FR-98): the team's monitor steps on live traffic (spec.pipelines.monitoring), from what capture records

min_samples.description: below this the window is insufficient_data, never no drift (default 500)

attribution.description: 1.4.3 (FR-98 stage 4): which features drive the answers, against training (permutation Shapley values)

health.description: 1.4.3 (FR-98): alert policies on each deployed version's errors, latency and replicas, whose incidents become serving.degraded and serving.recovered events

alerts.description: email notifications for Pipewright events (`pipewright alerts sync`)

time_column.description: the outcome's cut-off column: outcomes are joined to the scores made for that cut-off (the scores' scored_for), never to a later or earlier score (Pipewright 1.2.0)

features.description: online: the endpoint takes entity IDs and reads the features from the tenant's online store (Pipewright 1.1); request (the default): callers send the features

accelerator.description: a GPU per replica (Pipewright 1.2.0), within the environment's policies.accelerators.serving; machine must take it (e.g. g2-standard-8 with NVIDIA_L4)

capture.description: 1.4.3 (FR-98): record a sample of what the deployed version receives and answers, in the tenant's dataset (Agent Platform request logging, or KServe's logger through a log sink)

scale_to_zero.description: with replicas.min 0: an idle endpoint runs no replica, and the first request after a quiet spell waits for one to start (Pipewright 1.2.0; Agent Platform preview)

drain_seconds.description: seconds a version that no longer takes traffic keeps serving before it is undeployed, on a replace, a promote or an abandoned canary (Pipewright 1.4.2, FR-109, default 240): the endpoint goes on routing to it for a few minutes. 0 undeploys at once, as before

fill_missing.description: the endpoint fills an empty feature with its training median, as batch scoring does (Pipewright 1.2.0, default true); false: it answers an error naming the feature

pool.description: model co-hosting (Pipewright 1.4.2, FR-105): deploy onto this shared pool of the environment (manifest serving.pools) instead of the use case's own machines. Only when the team wants co-hosting; leave it out to deploy as before

online_store.description: which online store serves this use case's features (Pipewright 1.4.2, FR-104); without it the tenant's Bigtable online store (1.1). Needs model.serving.features online

type.description: bigtable (Feature Store, the default), bigquery (with BI Engine), cloudsql (PostgreSQL, synced by Pipewright) or http (the team's own store)

table.description: the served table in the tenant's dataset (default pw_online_<usecase>)

schema.description: where the table goes (default public; a named schema per team is the guideline in a shared instance)

table.description: the table, created at each sync (default pw_online_<usecase>)

lookup.description: between the endpoint and Cloud SQL: Pipewright's Cloud Run lookup service (the default) and its size, or the team's own. With mode gateway (1.4.2) also for type http: Pipewright's gateway in front of the team's own lookup service inside the network

mode.description: lookup (the default): the endpoint calls the lookup service for features. gateway (Pipewright 1.4.2, FR-106): callers send entity IDs to the lookup service inside the network, which reads the features and calls the endpoint itself; for endpoints that cannot reach the network

retries.description: gateway: how many times a prediction is tried again on 503, 429 or a dropped connection (default 3, so 4 tries, 0.25 to 2 s apart); 0 turns retries off

callers.description: gateway: who may call it (run.invoker on the lookup service), as serviceAccount:, group: or user: members

reader.description: provider own: the tenant's service account given SELECT

mode.description: full: every row each sync; changed: only rows whose values changed (less load on the database)

export.description: publish each generation as Parquet with a manifest, for a team's own store (off by default)

deploy_model.description: manual (the default): someone runs deploy-model --approve; auto: no confirmation; ci (Pipewright 1.2.0): a GitHub gate per new default version that passes its gates, approved by the environment's reviewers; on_register (1.2.0): the decisions workflow deploys such a version without a person

overrides.description: Keys that may vary per environment. Everything else is fixed so promotion compares like with like.

ab_test.description: per environment: whether the test runs there, the treatment (version numbers differ between environments), its allocation, duration, feed and approvers

synthetic.description: per environment: switch synthetic data on or off, how many rows, how long to train (gates and privacy stay fixed)

mode.description: YAML reads an unquoted off as false: both mean off

alerts.description: email notifications for Pipewright events (`pipewright alerts sync`)
